85177	A coupon that can be used to obtain the Caracal/Friends 2nd Title. When set as your 2nd Title, grants Production Success Rate +5%, Hillwen Engineering Quality +5 when used with the Expert Engineer title, and Magic Craft Quality +5 when used with the Magic Artisan title.
